mapper.subject: Leave request rejected --  Missing Supportnig Document

contents.text:
Dear {{2.`Full Name`}},

Your leave request has been reviewed by the system and was automatically rejected due to a policy violation.

Our records show that you requested more than 4 days of leave but did not upload the required supporting document. As per the company's leave policy, a valid supporting document is mandatory for all leave requests exceeding 4 days.

Please submit a new leave request with the required supporting document attached.

If you believe this rejection was made in error, please contact the HR department.

Thank you for your understanding.

Regards,
HR Team

mapper.subject: Leave Request Not Processed – Previous Request Pending

contents.text:
Dear {{2.`Full Name`}},

Your new leave request has not been processed because your previous leave request is still awaiting a manager's approval or rejection.

Please wait until you receive confirmation regarding your previous request before submitting a new leave request.

You will be notified once a decision has been made on your pending request.

Regards,
HR Team

mapper.content:
Dear {{2.`Full Name`}},

Your leave request has been automatically rejected because the requested leave dates overlap with an existing leave record under your Employee ID.

A new leave request cannot be processed while you already have leave scheduled for the same period.

Please review your existing leave dates and submit a new request with non-overlapping dates. If you believe this is an error, please contact the HR department.

Regards,
HR Team
mapper.subject: Leave request rejection -- Overlapped Invalid Dates.

contents.text:
Dear {{2.`Full Name`}},

Your leave request has been **automatically rejected** because one or more submitted details could not be validated.

Examples of invalid information include:

* Start Date is later than the End Date.
* Employee Name does not match the Employee ID.
* Department does not match the employee records.
* Invalid or mismatched email address.
* Other incorrect or inconsistent information.

Please review your submission, correct the invalid entries, and submit a new leave request.

If you believe the information you provided is correct, please contact the HR department for assistance.

Regards,
HR Team
